name: e2e-smoke
notes: First Slurm test of the whole path (scripts/e2e-batch.sh): one corpus-wide question (q01) and one ambiguous one (q10), claim_on only (claim_off and the attach step are dropped from the design, 14 Oct), two repeats = 4 runs. No budget here: the runs take the `agent run` defaults, so they test what the main runs will use. Concept paths are the frozen concept.json of each concept session ($CONCEPTS = concepts).
